BIOMEDTECH

Since 2001, Truffle has been a leading European and International Business Builder, which has contininuously grown first-in-class products. Discover more about how we continue to address unmet medical needs through radical innovation

Visit BioMedTech

FINTECH

Since 2015, Truffle has been a leading European VC in Fintech, with over 23 investments to date. Discover more about how we partner with world-class entrepreneurs to build category-defining leaders

Visit Fintech
TRUFFLE AT A GLANCE

For more than two decades, Truffle Capital has been a leading independent European Business Builder, at the forefront of creating, financing and nurturing innovation, playing a pivotal role in the growth and empowerment of technology leaders in two fields of expertise: Life Sciences (MedTech & Biotech) and Deeptech applied to Finance (Fintech & Insurtech).

Truffle Capital's mission is to drive the creation and development of companies on their journey to becoming tomorrow's leaders in BioMedTech and Finance/Insurance. Led by its two co-founders and CEOs, Philippe Pouletty, M.D. and Bernard-Louis Roques, Truffle Capital has €500M AuM, raising more than €1.2 Bn since its creation and supporting more than tens of companies with numerous successful exits. In line with its DNA, Truffle acts as a founder systematically in BioMedTech, a lead investor in financing rounds and is proactive in governance.

PRESENTATION

Since 2015, Truffle Capital has been at the forefront of FinTech innovation, leveraging an international team of investors and deep tech experts to empower Europe's leading innovators, forge strategic partnerships, and cultivate a dynamic ecosystem that fuels responsible economic growth.

THESIS
We actively foster strategic partnerships to build a robust ecosystem, accelerate the value and growth of our portfolio companies.

Fintech specialisation drives deeper insights, synergies and value-add for our portfolio and our LPs.

Deep leading edge technology creates unfair advantage for our portfolio.

Value-based investing drives capital efficiency and robust growth for our investments.

Focus on prioprietary AI, blockchain and cybersecurity technologies applied to financial institutions.

Systematic lead investor with a seat on the board.
